theorems.name: Submission.dgid_imrep_signed_density_representation
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (W S : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (β : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), MeasurableSet S → μHE[n] ((R.carrier ∩ W) \ S) = 0 → AEStronglyMeasurable β (μHE[n].restrict S) → (∀ x ∈ S, ξ x (β x) = 1) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ S)), R.orient x = ξ x ∨ R.orient x = -ξ x) → ∃ g : Euclid P → ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable g (μHE[n].restrict S) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict S), (∃ m : ℤ, g x = m) ∧ ‖g x‖ₑ ≤ R.carrier.indicator (fun y => (R.mult y : ℝ≥0∞)) x) ∧ ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, tsupport ω ⊆ W → R.action ω = ∫ x in S, g x * ξ x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
